items.title: Add modelwrapper methods to get network global input and output tensor names
items.body:
This fix adds the following helper methods in ModelWrapper:

global_in = model.get_global_in()
global_out = model.get_global_out()

This is meant to handle the following FINN issue: https://github.com/Xilinx/finn/pull/1494

Once this PR is approved, can use the new commit hash in the FINN fix and remove the duplicate definitions from my FINN fix.

items.title: Fix index out of bounds in version converter adapters

labels.name: module: version converter
labels.description: Issues related to ONNX version converter

items.body:
### Description
Several version converter adapters were accessing optional inputs without bounds checking, potentially causing index oob errors when those inputs were not provided. Added size checks before accessing inputs[1] in split, reshape, resize, scatter, and axes conversion adapters. Also added relevant tests

### Motivation and Context
Fixes #4874

items.title: Fix FOG shader issue in Compatibility mode
items.body:
Removing `#ifndef DISABLE_FOG` from two places to fix shader issues in Compatibility mode. Additionally, removing `if (scene_data.fog_enabled)` from the same, as the shader will not function properly in compatibility mode otherwise. Manually setting `fog_enabled` to `true` breaks the shader in a different way, implying that `fog_enabled` should not need to be `true` for this shader to function in compatibility mode.

- Fixes #94183
